title: Undergraduate Academic Calendar 2026/2027
text:
Dual Credit Programs with Ontario Secondary Schools
Laurier, in partnership with Ontario School Boards, may offer enriched
university preparatory
courses
in some high schools whereby
students
may receive dual
credit
for the
course
. The dual credit would be
applied toward both the Ontario Secondary School Diploma as well as toward an
undergraduate degree
program
at Laurier, should the
student
choose to register at Laurier.
Students will be informed in
advance by the individual school of the ability to gain university credit for a
particular course. Students who successfully complete the enriched course with
a minimum overall average of 75%, as well as a final exam grade of at least
75%, will receive a certificate from the secondary school. This certificate
will be presented after students have accepted an Offer of Admission to Wilfrid
Laurier University. The Admissions Office will add the transfer credit to the
student record.
